name: Mitsubishi Electric Corporation
summary: Mitsubishi Electric Corporation develops, manufactures, sells, and distributes electrical and electronic equipment. It operates through Infrastructure, Industry & Mobility, Life, Digital Innovation, Semiconductor & Device, and Others segments.
